name: BEANZ MP3 Player
author: BEANZ
description_short: Lightweight Nintendo GameCube MP3 player with SD browsing, simple playback controls, and custom wallpapers
description_long: Play MP3 music on Nintendo GameCube from SD2SP2 or SD Gecko storage. Includes a seven-row file browser, scrolling filenames, elapsed and total song time, and custom GameCube-themed wallpapers.
